interpretation: 两代理使用同一模型、上下文分离；此处仅为AI编码预验证。一致性不等于人类验证、构念效度或准确率；A/B均为各自参照，不能合成gold。

method.pair_eligibility: Both observations readable; domains additionally require both domain_state=specified; label U/uncertain excluded per label.
method.unspecified_domains: Excluded from domain binary comparisons; function comparisons remain eligible.
method.kappa_policy: Cohen kappa=(Po-Pe)/(1-Pe); null/NaN only if no evaluable pairs or abs(1-Pe)<=1e-12. A single constant rater does not make kappa undefined.
method.support_flags: one_rater_constant flags exactly one constant coder; low_positive_support flags fewer than 5 positives for either coder. These flags do not change kappa.
method.agreement_caveat: High overall agreement may be driven by shared negatives; it does not establish positive-label reliability, accuracy, or validity. Inspect positive agreement, marginal counts, and support flags.
method.missing_statistics: JSON null, CSV NaN; never silently replaced with zero.
method.reason_counts: Reasons can overlap, so their sum can exceed excluded_pairs.
